result.title: Recurrent Domain Incremental Adaptation of Time-Series Foundation Models
result.summary: Pretrained Time-Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) provide strong representations for downstream classification tasks. Yet adapting a TSFM under changing operating conditions remains challenging. A model must improve on each newly observed condition without sacrificing conditions it has already learned, often from only a small labeled calibration set and without knowing the operating condition at inference time. We find that this difficulty has an important geometric structure. Under an operating-condition shift, the embedding space of a TSFM does not move uniformly: some local regions change substantially, while others remain nearly unchanged. Consequently, a global adaptation can unnecessarily move embeddings that were already correctly classified. To address this, we propose the novel PACT (Piecewise Adaptation via Chart Transport). PACT partitions the frozen source embedding space into local charts and learns lightweight residual transports for the regions affected by each new condition. An explicit identity path is always retained, and a learned gate softly selects among the identity and accumulated transports for each input. The pretrained TSFM encoder, classifier head, and previously learned transports remain fixed. With only 5% labeled calibration data per arriving condition and no condition identity at test time, PACT maintains an average macro-F1 above 0.95 across a four-condition bearing-fault stream. Under homogeneous tasks and label spaces, similar retention-adaptation behavior is observed across public benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/Sachithx/PACT.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 PACT，将冻结的时序基础模型嵌入空间划分为局部 chart，为新工况学习轻量残差传输，并用门控在恒等路径与累积传输之间软选择，实现无需测试时工况标识的域增量适配。
AI.relevance_reason: 「保留恒等路径、仅局部改写受影响区域、门控软选择」的表示更新机制，可能为 LVR 中更新 latent 推理状态时避免破坏已正确内容提供可核查线索；但该文面向时序分类，与视觉推理无直接联系。
